import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Matrix {
        public static class Num {
            public long x;
            public static final long MOD = 1000000007;

            public Num() {
                this.x = 0;
            }

            public Num(long sig) {
                long sigt = sig % MOD;
                if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
                this.x = sigt;
            }

            public Num add(Num that) {
                long res = this.x + that.x;
                if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
                return new Num(res);
            }

            public Num subtract(Num that) {
                long res = this.x - that.x;
                if (res < 0) res += MOD;
                return new Num(res);
            }

            public Num multiply(Num that) {
                long res = (this.x * that.x) % MOD;
                return new Num(res);
            }
        }

        public List<List<Num>> v, w;

        public Matrix() {
            v = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        public Matrix(int n, int m) {
            v = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Num> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    row.add(new Num(0));
                }
                v.add(row);
            }
        }

        public int height() {
            return v.size();
        }

        public int width() {
            return v.get(0).size();
        }

        public Num at(int i, int j) {
            return v.get(i).get(j);
        }

        public void set(int i, int j, Num val) {
            v.get(i).set(j, val);
        }

        public static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix A = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                A.set(i, i, new Num(1));
            }
            return A;
        }

        public Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int n = this.height();
            int m = B.width();
            int p = B.height();
            if (p != this.width()) throw new AssertionError();

            w = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Num> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    row.add(new Num(0));
                }
                w.add(row);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    Num sum = new Num(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum = sum.add(this.at(i, k).multiply(B.at(k, j)));
                    }
                    w.get(i).set(j, sum);
                }
            }
            this.v = w;
            return this;
        }

        public static Matrix identityMatrix(int n) {
            return identity(n);
        }
    }

    static Matrix getRotateMatrix(int k, int t) {
        t = ((t % k) + k) % k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            A.set(i, (i + t) % k, new Matrix.Num(1));
        }
        A.set(k, k, new Matrix.Num(1));
        A.set(k + 1, k + 1, new Matrix.Num(1));
        A.set(k + 2, k + 2, new Matrix.Num(1));
        return A;
    }

    static Matrix getSingletonMatrix(int k, int j) {
        assert (0 <= j && j < k);
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j) {
                A.set(i, i, A.at(i, i).add(new Matrix.Num(1)));
            }
        }
        A.set(k + 1, k + 1, new Matrix.Num(1));
        A.set(k + 2, k + 2, new Matrix.Num(1));

        A.set(k, k + 1, A.at(k, k + 1).add(new Matrix.Num(1)));
        A.set(j, k + 1, A.at(j, k + 1).subtract(new Matrix.Num(1)));

        A.set(k, k, A.at(k, k).add(new Matrix.Num(2)));
        A.set(j, k, A.at(j, k).subtract(new Matrix.Num(1)));

        A.set(k, j, A.at(k, j).add(new Matrix.Num(1)));
        return A;
    }

    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            int k = sc.nextInt();

            Matrix b = new Matrix(1, k + 3);
            b.set(0, k, new Matrix.Num(1));
            b.set(0, k + 1, new Matrix.Num(1));
            b.set(0, k + 2, new Matrix.Num(1));

            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                digits++;
            }

            Matrix[] P = new Matrix[digits + 1];
            P[0] = getSingletonMatrix(k, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= digits; i++) {
                P[i] = Matrix.identity(k + 3);
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    P[i] = P[i].multiply(P[i - 1]);
                    P[i] = P[i].multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, -1));
                }
            }

            long offset = 0;
            int currentDigits = digits;
            long currentPowk = powk;
            while (currentPowk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / currentPowk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    b = b.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, -s));
                    b = b.multiply(P[currentDigits]);
                    b = b.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, s));
                    offset += currentPowk;
                }
                currentPowk /= k;
                currentDigits--;
            }

            System.out.println(b.at(0, k + 1).x);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
